verdict.rationale: Coinbase Payments provides official client SDKs (cdp-sdk on GitHub for EVM/Solana wallets), plus CLI and MCP server tooling explicitly aimed at AI-native/agentic use (x402 payments, MCP for AI assistants, wallet-per-agent support), all documented first-party. Missing for 10: independent/third-party corroboration of SDK quality and a public OpenAPI spec (probe found openapi.json 404s), which would strengthen developer trust.
